notes: Recorded 207 bachelor, 175 master, 68 doctorate and 13 diploma rows (diploma includes higher diplomas) = 463 programme-by-university rows, from 633 individual platform listings at 12 public universities (124 Full scholarship and 509 Partial scholarship listings). Several listings of the same programme (male and female campuses, Arabic and English versions, international and resident students) are merged into one row per programme and university, and the row detail states which scholarship type, campus, gender, language and duration the listings show.
The platform's own counts on the day of reading: 124 Full scholarship listings, 603 Partial scholarship listings and 917 Paid Study listings. Paid Study listings are self-funded and are NOT recorded.

94 Full or Partial listings at three private institutions (Mustaqbal University, Buraydah Private Colleges, Sulaiman Al-Rajhi University) are NOT recorded, because the Ministry scheme is for public universities. Mustaqbal's 20 Other-type listings are qualifying preparatory programmes.

The platform shows its Full and Partial listings for 2026-27 (1448 AH) and the list changes continuously. Programmes at Qassim University, Umm al-Qura University, King Abdulaziz University, King Saud University, King Faisal University, the Islamic University of Madinah, Northern Border University, Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, Imam Muhammad bin Saud Islamic University, Jouf University, University of Jeddah and King Khalid University are covered; the Ministry says 27 public universities take part, so universities with no listing on the platform are not in this list.

Health and medical programmes: the Ministry text excludes health and medical specialisations, but the platform lists some health-related programmes (for example Master of Nursing, Master of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medicine (special talents)) as Partial scholarships at some public universities. They are recorded as the platform shows them; editors may want to check them against the Ministry's exclusion.

Programme names are the English names the platform prints (title case applied where it printed capitals only); the Arabic title is in source_text. Where the platform's English label is only 'New program' (Islamic University of Madinah and Imam Muhammad bin Saud Islamic University), the name is the Arabic title.
One listing (King Faisal University, Applied Economics, master) shows a duration of 20 years on the platform, which looks like a data error on the source.
not_stated: The platform shows no faculty or field group per programme; the Ministry's page states no list of participating universities.
fetch_problems: The platform pages loaded without a login. Detail pages for each programme were not opened one by one: the card data (type, campus, gender, language, duration) is taken from the results list.
